channel.title: Pharma and biotech: Korean small and mid-cap filings
channel.description: New filings from Korean small and mid-cap companies in the pharma and biotech sector.

item.title: BIO-FD&C: BIO-FD&C terminated a KRW 1.92bn plant cell platform supply contract with Estelab on 27 November 2026 after counterparty defaults.
Green Lifescience: Green Lifescience signed a KRW 16.75bn AI semiconductor material supply contract with related party Green Chemical, running 27 Nov 2026 to 30 Apr 2027.
Quratis: Quratis signed a KRW 533.48 million clinical drug supply contract with the University of North Carolina, equal to 21.71% of recent revenue.
Corestemchemon: Corestemchemon filed an IND with Korea's MFDS on 2026-11-25 for a Phase 3b trial of Neuronata-R in ALS patients.
Yungjin Pharm: Korea Exchange warns Yungjin Pharm common shares may be designated administrative issue after 25 trading days below KRW 1,000 close.
Corestemchemon: Corestemchemon signed a KRW 2.27bn contract with Incheon Regional Public Procurement Service for chemical hazard test data production.
Access Bio: Access Bio's board approved a KRW 10bn trust contract with Korea Investment & Securities to acquire treasury shares for price stabilization and shareholder value.
Aribiolab: Aribiolab's largest shareholder Aribio Holdings pledged all 3,948,813 shares to Aribio Co. as security for a KRW 4.0bn loan.
Aribiolab: Aribiolab's largest shareholder Aribio Holdings had its pledge on 3,948,813 shares released on 23 November 2026 after repaying a KRW 4.0bn loan.
Hans Biomed: Hans Biomed reports FY2026 consolidated revenue up 51.7% to KRW 136.3bn, with operating profit turning positive at KRW 11.8bn.
Aimed Bio: Aimed Bio submitted a Phase 1 IND application to the US FDA for AMB303 in advanced or metastatic solid tumor and lymphoma patients.
item.description: AMB303 Phase 1 IND submitted to FDA

item.title: Korea United Pharm: Korea United Pharm's co-developed knee osteoarthritis drug USI002 had a Phase 3 clinical trial plan filed with Korea's MFDS on November 23, 2026.
curacle: Curacle filed a US FDA IND application on 2026-11-20 for a Phase 2b trial of CU06-1004 in diabetic macular edema.
item.description: Phase 2b IND filed with US FDA

item.title: Aprogen: Aprogen resolved on Nov 20, 2026 to issue 1,428,571 new common shares at KRW 1,400 each via a public offering.
TimeX AI: TimeX AI common stock trading suspension to be lifted on November 20, 2026, upon listing of shares changed by reverse split.
Eutilex: Eutilex's largest shareholder changed to Kwon Byung-se and 3 related parties with 12.18% after shares transferred in December 2025 were returned.
Abion: Abion was granted a six-month improvement period by the KOSDAQ Market Committee on November 18, 2026, ending May 18, 2027.
Peptron: Peptron received MFDS approval on 2026-11-18 for a Phase 1 trial of PT403 in obesity, enrolling 22 healthy adults.
GeneOne Life Science: GeneOne Life Science filed an objection on 19 November 2026 to the delisting decision from its listing eligibility review.
Curocell: Curocell received MFDS approval on 2026-11-18 to amend the Phase 1/2 IND for CRC01 in relapsed or refractory adult B-ALL.
item.description: MFDS approves CRC01 B-ALL IND amendment

item.title: Abion: Abion's trading suspension extended after KOSDAQ granted an improvement period, ending May 18, 2027, with a delisting decision to follow.
WooGeneB&GCO: WooGeneB&GCO largest shareholder Kang Jae-gu released a pledge on 127,706 shares after fully repaying a KRW 290mn IBK loan.
Celemics: Celemics largest shareholder Park Jong-gab pledges 487,425 shares as collateral for KRW 3.2bn loan guarantee; enforcement would cut stake to 6.80%.
JS Link: JS Link signs KRW 2.24bn long-read sequencing data production contract with Korea Research Institute of Bioscience and Biotechnology
WooGeneB&GCO: WooGeneB&GCO decides to issue 600,000 new common shares at KRW 2,500 to J Global fund, raising KRW 1.5bn.
Celestra: Celestra's Q3 revenue fell below KRW 300 million, an added listing eligibility review ground, but procedures are on hold pending litigation.
Cellumed: Cellumed amends its capital reduction plan, increasing the cancelled shares of its largest shareholder to 19,000,000 and postponing the schedule.
Cellumed: Cellumed's board decided a 22.54% differential capital reduction, cancelling 18,761,339 common shares held by its largest shareholder, TD Landmark Partnership No. 1.
Prestige Biologics: Prestige Biologics signed a commercial drug substance contract manufacturing contract worth KRW 15.5bn, equal to 58.11% of recent revenue.
Olipass: KOSDAQ notes Ollipass's latest quarterly revenue is below KRW 300 million, an added review ground, but procedures stay on hold pending litigation.
PharmaResearch: Pharma Research reported Q3 2026 consolidated revenue of KRW 171.5bn, up 26.7% year on year, with operating profit of KRW 62.6bn.
JW Lifescience: JW Life Science reported Q3 2026 standalone preliminary revenue of KRW 56.7bn and operating profit of KRW 8.0bn.
Yungjin Pharm: Youngjin Pharmaceutical reported Q3 2026 provisional revenue of KRW 62.7bn and an operating loss of KRW 2.3bn versus a small profit a year earlier.
GC Biopharma: GC Biopharma-named filer Green Cross signs KRW 59.2bn influenza vaccine supply contract with VaxThera Zona Franca S.A.S. for Colombia.
GC Biopharma: GC Biopharma reported Q3 2026 consolidated revenue of KRW 522.1bn and operating profit of KRW 49.2bn, unaudited.
Dong-a ST: Dong-A ST received MFDS approval on 2026-10-30 for Stillen Q Tab, a once-daily acute and chronic gastritis treatment.
item.description: MFDS approval of Stillen Q Tab
